description:
IAP Desktop is a Windows application that allows you to manage multiple Remote Desktop connections to Windows VM instances that run on Google Cloud. This is not an officially supported Google product.


Release 2.51 includes several security improvements, including the following:

• The workforce identity sign-in process now uses [PKCE](https://oauth.net/2/pkce/).

**Important**：Workforce identity federation may soon block sign-ins that don't use PKCE. Older versions of IAP Desktop may then no longer be able to sign in using workforce identity.

In addition, the release includes several stability improvements and fixes for the following issues:

• Connecting to a server that uses SSH keyboard-interactive login with a custom 
  instruction message could cause IAP Desktop to crash.
• Using SFTP to download a file with certain characters in its file name could fail
  or cause IAP Desktop to place the file in the wrong location.
• For certain fatal errors, IAP Desktop wasn't able to display an accurate
  error description because the error handling caused cascading errors.

IAP Desktop is developed and maintained by [jpassing](https://www.jpassing.com/).
